nodes.label: AI Network Switch Silicon
nodes.what: High-radix Ethernet switch ASICs (e.g. 102.4 Tbps Tomahawk-class) used for AI scale-up and scale-out fabrics.
nodes.why_matters: Determines how many XPUs can be connected per tier and how many optics/tiers a cluster needs.
nodes.falsify: Multiple vendors ship 100T+ AI Ethernet ASICs with spare foundry capacity and short lead times.

nodes.label: High-Speed SerDes
nodes.what: 100G/200G+ SerDes lanes connecting switch silicon to copper or optical modules.
nodes.why_matters: Electrical reach and power-per-bit limit how far copper can go before optics are required.
nodes.falsify: Passive copper covers most AI rack/row interconnect without optical conversion at target speeds.

nodes.label: 800G / 1.6T Optical Transceivers
nodes.what: Pluggable optical modules carrying cluster east-west traffic at 800G and emerging 1.6T rates.
nodes.why_matters: As switch bandwidth doubles, module count and speed must rise or fabrics stall.
nodes.falsify: 800G/1.6T modules available with short lead times and declining ASP across suppliers.

nodes.label: Optical DSP / PHY
nodes.what: PAM4 optical DSPs/PHYs inside high-speed modules (200G/lane → 400G/lane).
nodes.why_matters: DSPs gate module power, BER, and ability to ship 800G/1.6T at scale.
nodes.falsify: Multiple DSP vendors ship qualified 200G/400G-lane silicon with excess capacity.

nodes.label: Laser Sources
nodes.what: EML, VCSEL, and CW lasers supplying light for optical interconnect (pluggable and CPO).
nodes.why_matters: Without qualified laser volume, modules and CPO engines cannot ship.
nodes.falsify: EML/CW/VCSEL supply exceeds AI optics demand with diversified foundries.

nodes.label: Optical Engines / Silicon Photonics
nodes.what: Integrated optical engines and SiPho assemblies used in CPO and advanced interconnect.
nodes.why_matters: Moves conversion closer to the switch ASIC; required for CPO bandwidth density.
nodes.falsify: Optical engines available as commodity attach with mature yields independent of switch vendor.

nodes.label: Co-Packaged Optics Integration
nodes.what: Packaging optical engines with switch ASICs to shorten electrical I/O paths.
nodes.why_matters: Candidate relief for SerDes power/reach walls at 102.4T+ switching.
nodes.falsify: CPO widely deployed in production AI fabrics with proven service model.

nodes.label: Networking Advanced Packaging
nodes.what: Advanced package integration for switch + optics (including CPO package complexes).
nodes.why_matters: CPO and high-SerDes switches require specialized packaging beyond standard ASIC packages.
nodes.falsify: CPO/switch packages assemble with commodity packaging capacity and high yields.

nodes.label: Network Power Consumption
nodes.what: Energy consumed by switches, SerDes, DSPs, lasers, and optical conversion in AI fabrics.
nodes.why_matters: Optical interconnect power is a stated limiter of cluster scalability.
nodes.falsify: Networking power ceases to constrain AI cluster size vs compute/power budget.

nodes.label: Network Thermal Management
nodes.what: Cooling of high-power switch systems, DSPs, lasers, and CPO packages.
nodes.why_matters: As power density rises, thermal design gates density and reliability.
nodes.falsify: Air-cooled networking meets 102.4T+ density targets without thermal throttling.
